acceptanceCriteria: A measured trace shows the git calls one enrolled Stop makes before and after, with duplicates removed.
Stop results are unchanged on the existing Stop tests.
Per-Stop CPU before and after is recorded on the same host.
body: Found in lane G (V1-1120, PR beamfall/corvint#746). One enrolled Stop evaluation makes about 12 git calls, repeating rev-parse, status and ls-tree: about 0.37 s CPU against about 1.5 s wall under load. Under machine load of 150 or more on 12 CPUs, Stop fails open with dogfood-event-deadline (LCP-V0-008) at 1.53-2.07 s from spawn (V1-1120 load envelope: below 150, 0/92 failed; 150-199, 2/3; 200+, 14/17). Removing duplicate git calls would cut per-Stop CPU and widen that envelope without changing any deadline. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-10-hlq-load-failures.md on #746.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#761 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/761; landed by batch PR #789); on main at 00dd220753973cd7eb332b3b7572db4a2ca60265 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/789). Tests named in the PR: TestEnrolledStopSpawnsBoundedGit, TestEvaluateAgainst*, TestDogfoodEventObservedMismatchFallsBack. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: Deduplicate snapshot git calls in enrolled Stop evaluation to widen the Stop deadline envelope under load
